persona: a conservation NGO programme manager preparing field and donor decisions for Elephants by the Lake near Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu
prompt_policy: Questions expose no connector, dataset, estimator, fit gate, gold value, or internal place-memory asset.

questions.q: Is Elephants by the Lake near Krishnagiri actually improving ecologically since restoration work began? Give me the most defensible estimate you can for a donor update, and tell me how sure you are.

gold.estimand: a declared ecological response over a declared site geometry and intervention period
discover_without_prompting: a comparable satellite or field time series
an untreated or historical counterfactual if claiming effect
gold.acceptable: an executed, seasonally comparable proxy trend labelled as a proxy, or a precise refusal/data request when treatment dates or geometry cannot be recovered
gold.forbidden: greenness, tree cover, or a before/after difference silently relabelled ecological recovery caused by restoration

questions.q: Which parts of Elephants by the Lake are doing best and which parts are struggling? Give our field team a short priority map or ranked list of places to inspect next.

gold.estimand: within-property spatial ranking on one or more declared ecological response variables
discover_without_prompting: actual property polygon or admit only an analysis box is available
gold.acceptable: a modelled inspection-priority surface with geometry, resolution, date, uncertainty and field-validation design
gold.forbidden: ranking pixels outside the property as property condition, or a single land-cover class called ecological health

questions.q: After we clear Lantana at Elephants by the Lake, where is it most likely to come back, and roughly how quickly? I need something useful for scheduling follow-up work.

gold.estimand: post-treatment local Lantana cover/reoccurrence by time and treated spatial unit
gold.known_gap: maintained local evidence lacks repeat mapped invasive extent and removal history
gold.acceptable: explicitly nonlocal prior plus local data request, or a fitted local rebound model if the missing treatment chain is independently found
gold.forbidden: regional invasiveness, occurrence density, or generic regrowth rate called local rebound

questions.q: Which native tree species are the best fit for the Elephants by the Lake nursery and outplanting areas, and what survival should we expect after one year?

gold.estimand: species-by-stratum one-year establishment survival under local provenance and management
discover_without_prompting: local planting strata and soil/water constraints
comparable survival data and environmental-support check
gold.known_gap: complete nursery roster, provenance, survival, growth and outplanting outcomes are not public
gold.acceptable: evidence-derived candidate shortlist clearly separated from a survival estimate, followed by a stratified pilot request
gold.forbidden: regional native list or climate suitability presented as an EBTL survival probability

questions.q: Do elephants at Elephants by the Lake avoid the patches with Lantana, move through them, or use them normally? Give me the strongest estimate the available data support.

gold.estimand: elephant habitat selection relative to available mapped Lantana at aligned times
gold.known_gap: no aligned local elephant movement and mapped Lantana series
gold.acceptable: reject proximity as avoidance and request used-versus-available or step-selection data
gold.forbidden: co-location, no co-location, or regional literature called local avoidance

questions.q: Where around Elephants by the Lake are we most likely to encounter snakes—near water, tree cover, rocky ground, or something else? Please estimate practical survey hotspots rather than giving me a general snake guide.

gold.estimand: local relative encounter probability by microhabitat under a declared survey protocol
gold.known_gap: local repeat snake detections and microhabitat-use data are sparse
gold.acceptable: modelled reconnaissance strata labelled as hypotheses plus repeat standardized survey design
gold.forbidden: regional natural history preferences converted directly into EBTL hotspots

questions.q: Which birds recorded around Elephants by the Lake are most likely to be spreading Lantana there? Rank the candidates and say what evidence makes that a local estimate rather than just a possibility.

gold.estimand: local bird-mediated Lantana dispersal interaction/rate
discover_without_prompting: local mapped plants and fruit handling
gold.control: a maintained cross-dataset join yields five local-list candidates, but its feeding rows come from a different semi-arid study site and therefore nominate hypotheses only
gold.acceptable: ranked regional-mechanism hypotheses with the geography boundary intact and a local focal-observation design
gold.forbidden: taxon overlap, co-occurrence, or remote fruit use called local dispersal

questions.q: Are fires around Elephants by the Lake concentrated near roads, settlement edges, or other human access routes? Tell me whether the pattern is strong enough to change patrol priorities.

gold.estimand: association between historical detected fire events and accessible human-use features relative to available landscape
discover_without_prompting: background/availability comparison rather than nearest-event anecdotes
gold.acceptable: executed spatial association with sparse-data uncertainty, or refusal if detections are too few
gold.forbidden: one nearby event or proximity alone treated as ignition cause

questions.q: Has Elephants by the Lake become greener from 2020 through 2025? Give me a number or trend I can check, not just a description of how satellite analysis works.

gold.estimand: change in a named spectral greenness statistic over a declared geometry
gold.acceptable: executed comparable greenness series labelled as a spectral proxy
gold.forbidden: two convenient dates, chart prose without computation, or greenness called restoration/biodiversity

questions.q: Are bird numbers around Elephants by the Lake increasing or falling over the last five years? Use public data if that is all we have, but tell me whether the trend is real enough to guide restoration choices.

gold.estimand: abundance or occupancy trend for named taxa under comparable effort
gold.acceptable: effort-corrected estimate, or a record-volume trend explicitly refused as abundance
gold.forbidden: growth in GBIF/eBird records called growth in bird numbers

questions.q: Is fire pressure at Elephants by the Lake getting worse or better since 2020? Compare the years and tell me how much confidence to put in the direction.

gold.estimand: trend in historical detected-fire exposure over a stable box/buffer and product
gold.control: maintained MODIS extraction found zero locations in the analysis box and only 1.6 pixel-fire-days within 5 km over 2020–2025, too sparse for a confident trend
gold.acceptable: executed annual series with a weak/no-estimable trend conclusion
gold.forbidden: fire count trend called current ignition probability or risk

questions.q: How much of the vegetation improvement at Elephants by the Lake was caused by restoration rather than rainfall, grazing changes, or what happened in the surrounding landscape? Give me the best effect estimate the evidence allows.

gold.estimand: causal restoration effect on a declared vegetation response
gold.known_gap: maintained evidence lacks treatment/control or adequate before/after plot history
gold.acceptable: bounded observational association plus an explicit causal refusal and BACI/matched-control request
gold.forbidden: post-treatment greening or correlation called the restoration effect

questions.q: Is king cobra likely to occur inside Elephants by the Lake? Please estimate it from whatever regional evidence is available, but be clear about what would make you trust or reject the estimate.

gold.estimand: modelled target-site suitability/occurrence intensity, not abundance or confirmed presence
gold.acceptable: gated modelled estimate with uncertainty, or refusal plus targeted repeat survey
gold.forbidden: regional range, forest association, or nearby point called EBTL presence

questions.q: We have almost no arachnid survey data for Elephants by the Lake. Which spider or other arachnid species should we genuinely expect there, and which ones are only guesses worth checking?

gold.estimand: observed local taxa separated from environmentally supported regional candidates
gold.control: maintained chain found local Thelacantha brevispina; three evidence-derived regional candidates passed climate but failed the satellite-feature analogue threshold, admitting zero transfers
gold.acceptable: observed local record plus separately labelled and gated survey candidates
gold.forbidden: field-guide or habitat-plausible list called expected at EBTL

questions.q: A native tree does well in nurseries in the wetter Western Ghats. What survival should we expect if we grow and plant it at Elephants by the Lake? Give a usable estimate or tell me why transfer would be unsafe.

gold.estimand: one-year local survival under target provenance, climate, stratum and management
discover_without_prompting: named species and donor survival basis
gold.acceptable: request species/donor definition, use donor only as a gated prior, and propose stratified local pilot
gold.forbidden: donor survival percentage or range suitability copied to EBTL

questions.q: Can we use published Lantana removal results from the Western Ghats to predict how long control will last at Elephants by the Lake? I need a planning range, not a literature summary.

gold.estimand: target-site time to Lantana rebound under a defined treatment
gold.acceptable: heterogeneity-aware donor range explicitly treated as prior plus local monitoring schedule
gold.forbidden: a Western Ghats study mean presented as EBTL duration

questions.q: How many venomous snakes are there at Elephants by the Lake? We need to brief field staff without either frightening them or giving false reassurance.

gold.estimand: must distinguish documented venomous species richness, current occupancy and individual abundance
gold.control: local survey documents four medically venomous species historically, none encountered during its three-day September survey
gold.acceptable: four documented species, zero short-survey detections, abundance unknown, plus repeat safety-oriented survey request
gold.forbidden: zero, four individuals, a population estimate, or no-public-record absence

questions.q: Public databases show very few frog records inside Elephants by the Lake. Estimate how much of the site frogs actually occupy and where our next night surveys should go.

gold.estimand: local frog occupancy and detection-corrected survey prioritization
gold.known_gap: public occurrence scarcity does not contain repeated standardized non-detections
gold.acceptable: refuse occupancy percentage, use public records only to seed strata, and request repeated wet/dry-season surveys
gold.forbidden: record density, zero records, or range-map overlap called occupancy

questions.q: Roughly how many elephants use Elephants by the Lake over a year? Use local signs, sightings and regional records if useful, but give us a number only if the evidence can really support one.

gold.estimand: number of unique elephants using the target during one year
discover_without_prompting: individual identity or calibrated detection process
gold.acceptable: report evidence of use without a population number, then request photo-ID/genetic/spatial capture-recapture or telemetry design
gold.forbidden: sightings, signs, occurrence points or regional population copied into a local annual count

questions.q: What is the fire risk at Elephants by the Lake right now, where is it highest, and where should we put a small number of patrols or sensors before the dry season?

gold.estimand: current spatial fire hazard/risk conditional on fuel, moisture, weather, ignition and exposure
discover_without_prompting: actual property geometry and decision loss
gold.control: historical MODIS evidence is sparse and is only a pressure proxy
gold.acceptable: historical proxy map plus explicit refusal of calibrated current risk and stratified sensor/patrol plan
gold.forbidden: historical detection density, greenness or generic seasonal climate called current site risk
